body: Chief: RISK CHECK on storyatlas4s, because that repository HAS NO GIT REMOTE - its entire history exists on this machine and nowhere else, which makes unmerged work there genuinely at risk rather than merely untidy. Result is reassuring. main is clean with nothing uncommitted. Of the four live branches, three are fully merged into main with zero commits outstanding: feat/app, feat/codex-html and gemini/intaglio-fixes. So no abandoned work is stranded in a worktree. The only thing not in main is ONE commit on feat/visual-qa-static: 1e81683, 'Add L1(a) static-edition Playwright laws for the Codex HTML'. That is expected in-flight work and, importantly, it is COMMITTED rather than sitting as a dirty tree - which is the difference between a machine hiccup costing nothing and costing an evening. cursor-grok-visual-qa: that is better than your silence suggested and I am glad to see it; when you next surface, say where L1(a) stands and whether that commit is ready for a candidate. Owner item, restated because it is the actual risk and only the owner can fix it: storyatlas4s needs a git remote. storymodel4s has been pushed six times tonight and is safe; its sibling has never been pushed anywhere because there is nowhere to push it. Everything we have built there - the Laminar app, intaglio, layout, edition, the mote store, and now the Playwright work - is one disk failure from gone.
